name: JAKS
recent: JAKS Resources 正在推进最多 10% 已发行股份的私募配售，并已向交易所提交额外上市申请。公司同时延长了出售 JAKS Solar Nibong Tebal 全部股权的条件满足期限至 2027 年 3 月 31 日，完成日延至 2027 年 5 月 31 日。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）净利为 1,306 万令吉，营收环比增长 19.8%。
notable: 集资用于偿还债务及营运资金。
500 万令吉现金出售 JAKS Solar Nibong Tebal 全部股权，并由买方结算该公司欠 JAKS 最多 4,000 万令吉的款项。
2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度净利 1,306 万令吉，营收 1,115 万令吉。
risks: 私募配售最多 10% 新股可能摊薄现有股东持股。
出售 JAKS Solar Nibong Tebal 的条件满足期限已延长至 2027 年 3 月 31 日，完成日延至 2027 年 5 月 31 日。
公司有一项重大诉讼公告（2026 年 11 月 4 日）。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收 1,115 万令吉，环比增长 19.8%，同比减少 7.8%；净利 1,306 万令吉，环比减少 22.9%，同比增长 30.9%；净利率 117.1%，低于上季度的 182.1%。

recent_en: JAKS Resources is proceeding with a private placement of up to 10% of its issued shares and has submitted the additional listing application to the exchange. The company also extended the deadline for fulfilling conditions of the disposal of JAKS Solar Nibong Tebal to 31 March 2027, with completion extended to 31 May 2027. Latest quarter (ended 30 June 2026) net profit was RM13.06 million, with revenue up 19.8% QoQ.
notable_en: Proposed private placement of up to 10% of issued shares to raise funds for debt repayment and working capital.
Proposed disposal of 100% equity interest in JAKS Solar Nibong Tebal for RM15 million cash, with the buyer settling up to RM40 million owed by the company to JAKS.
Net profit of RM13.06 million on revenue of RM11.15 million for the quarter ended 30 June 2026.
risks_en: Private placement of up to 10% new shares may dilute existing shareholders.
The deadline for fulfilling conditions of the JAKS Solar Nibong Tebal disposal has been extended to 31 March 2027, with completion extended to 31 May 2027.
The company has a material litigation announcement (4 November 2026).
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM11.15 million, up 19.8% QoQ but down 7.8% YoY; net profit was RM13.06 million, down 22.9% QoQ but up 30.9% YoY; net margin was 117.1%, lower than 182.1% in the previous quarter.
